## 💡 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or improvement you would like to see.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a problem or workflow friction?
*Example: "I'm always frustrated when I want to..."*

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. How should the user interface or behavior work?

## 🔍 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## 🎨 Visuals or Mockups
If applicable, attach rough sketches, diagrams, or references of how the UI should look.

## ⚙️ Additional Context
Any additional context or details about the feature request here.
